title: {{NAME}} and the Unicorn's Missing Sparkle
moral: You can always find something beautiful if you look with a kind heart.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} walked along a path of silver grass.
The moon was just coming up over the hill.
Owls and foxes moved softly in the dark.
A white unicorn stood alone in the clearing.
Her horn was not glowing at all.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} walked slowly up to the unicorn.
She had big sad silver eyes.
"My sparkle is gone," she said softly.
"Without it, the night flowers will not bloom."
{{NAME}} felt a tug in his heart.

pages.content:
A little golden fairy flew down from the moon.
She looked at the unicorn's horn closely.
"The sparkle fell into the deep pond," she said.
She flew down and pulled it out.
It was a tiny glowing drop of light!

pages.content:
The fairy pressed the sparkle back onto the horn.
The horn lit up with a bright warm glow.
All the night flowers burst into bloom.
Pink and gold flowers opened everywhere.
{{NAME}} gasped. It was so beautiful.

pages.content:
The whole clearing glowed and smelled so sweet.
The fox and owl crept closer to see.
The unicorn nuzzled {{NAME}} with her soft nose.
The golden fairy rested on {{NAME}}'s shoulder.
He felt so happy and warm and very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow the unicorn wants to show you where the sparkles come from.
